item.text: The dataset is a 256×256 scalar time series with 34 frames. I’ll use the first three chronological frames (`cloud1–3`) and apply TTK’s persistence-threshold simplifier at 0.5 before extracting and transporting maxima.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "/opt/conda/bin/pvpython - <<'PY'
import vtk, topologytoolkit as ttk
r=vtk.vtkXMLImageDataReader();r.SetFileName('/workspace/cloud/cloud1.vti');r.Update()
s=ttk.ttkTopologicalSimplificationByPersistence();s.SetInputData(r.GetOutput());s.SetInputArrayToProcess(0,0,0,0,'Scalars_');s.SetPersistenceThreshold(.5);s.SetThresholdIsAbsolute(True);s.Update()
o=s.GetOutput();print(o, o.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays())
for i in range(o.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays()): print(o.GetPointData().GetArrayName(i),o.GetPointData().GetArray(i).GetRange())
PY"

item.text:
Completed the requested TTK persistence simplification (threshold 0.5) and EMD-based piecewise-linear maximum tracking across `cloud1–3`.

Outputs are in [cloud_results](/workspace/cloud_results):

- [Original scalar-field render](/workspace/cloud_results/original_scalar_field_cloud1.png)
- [Tracked maxima visualization (warm–cold)](/workspace/cloud_results/tracked_maxima_warm_cold.png)
- [Radius-2 maximum spheres for ParaView](/workspace/cloud_results/tracked_maxima_spheres_radius_2.vtp)
- [EMD piecewise-linear tracks for ParaView](/workspace/cloud_results/emd_piecewise_linear_tracks.vtp)
- [EMD transport edges](/workspace/cloud_results/emd_maxima_tracks.csv)
- Simplified scalar fields: `cloud[1-3]_persistence_0.5.vti`

The reproducible workflow is saved in [cloud_tracking.py](/workspace/cloud_tracking.py).
